The great aqueduct associated with Zempoala was built in that century, linking water supply to the transformation of the colonial landscape. Farming and established community ties continued through these changes.
simp_chinese:
塞姆波阿拉位于墨西哥中部高地，今属伊达尔戈州。田地、丘陵和水源构成农业社群的生活环境，道路连接邻近地区。殖民统治以前，这里曾处于特斯科科的统治之下。

十六世纪西班牙征服带来殖民行政、基督教机构及新的劳役要求，疫病也严重破坏原住民社群。与塞姆波阿拉有关的大型引水渠建于这一世纪，体现了殖民时期水利与地方景观的变化。居民在这些转变中继续耕作并维持社群联系。

english: Vesij, also known as Zernuk, was a town near a crossing of the Syr Darya in the Otrar region. The site called Oksus or Oksyz is associated with this medieval settlement. Roads from Otrar led across the river here toward the towns and deserts to the west. Medieval accounts connect Vesij with the birthplace of the philosopher Abu Nasr al-Farabi, whose learning became celebrated throughout the Islamic world. The crossing joined the river oasis to the wider caravan routes of Central Asia.
simp_chinese: 瓦西吉又称泽尔努克，是讹答剌地区锡尔河渡口附近的一座城镇。名为奥克苏斯或奥克瑟兹的遗址与这一中世纪聚落有关。从讹答剌来的道路在这里渡河，通向西方的城镇和沙漠。中世纪记述将瓦西吉与哲学家阿布·纳斯尔·法拉比的出生地联系起来，他的学问在伊斯兰世界广受推崇。渡口将河流绿洲与中亚更广阔的商道相连。

english: Zengkou lies on the Ba River southeast of Bazhou, where a river landing links the surrounding hills with the waterway. The place was once the seat of a county under Bazhou; in the early Ming the county was abolished and absorbed into the prefecture. Its name is locally associated with fishing nets worked along the riverbank, a reminder of the river's place in the life of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 曾口位于巴州东南的巴河边，河岸渡口将周围丘陵与水路相连。这里曾是巴州属县的治所，明初曾口县被省入巴州。地方上将地名与河岸使用的罾网捕鱼联系起来，反映了江河在聚落生活中的地位。

english: Zenica lies in a broad field along the Bosna River, between the Vranduk and Lašva gorges. Nearby Janjići was for a time a seat of the medieval Bosnian Church. The name Zenica appears in a Ragusan document of 1436, in connection with an Ottoman raid. After the Ottoman conquest, the town grew along the river; in 1697 it was burned during the campaign of the Habsburg commander Eugene of Savoy.
simp_chinese: 泽尼察坐落在波斯纳河畔宽阔的平地上，介于弗兰杜克和拉什瓦两处峡谷之间。附近的亚尼奇曾一度是中世纪波斯尼亚教会的中心。泽尼察之名见于1436年的拉古萨文书，记载与一次奥斯曼袭击有关。奥斯曼征服后，城镇沿河发展；1697年，哈布斯堡统帅欧根亲王率军远征时，泽尼察遭到焚毁。

english: Zenina lies in the high country west of Djelfa, where the Ouled Naïl ranges approach the open steppe. Seasonal watercourses run through a landscape occupied by herding communities for a very long time; rock engravings in the wider region preserve traces of much older inhabitants and their animals. The neighbouring country was home to the Ouled Saad ben Salem, whose camps were part of the social landscape around Laghouat.
simp_chinese: 泽尼纳位于杰勒法以西的高地，乌莱德纳伊勒山脉在这里接近开阔草原。季节性河道穿过这片土地，牧业社群在此生活已有漫长历史；周边地区的岩刻保存着更早居民及动物的痕迹。邻近地区是乌莱德·萨阿德·本·萨莱姆人的家园，他们的营地是艾格瓦特周围社会景观的一部分。

english: Zenta, also known as Senta, stands on the Tisza in the fertile plain of northern Bačka. King Vladislaus II granted it the status of a free royal town in 1506, before the Ottoman conquest transformed the region. The river gave its name to a decisive battle on 11 September 1697: Prince Eugene of Savoy attacked the Ottoman army as it crossed the Tisza and won a major victory. After the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699, Zenta became part of the Habsburg Military Frontier along the Tisza and Maros.
simp_chinese: 曾陶又称森塔，坐落在北巴奇卡肥沃平原的蒂萨河畔。1506年，乌拉斯洛二世国王授予它自由王室城市地位，之后奥斯曼征服改变了这一地区。1697年9月11日，一场决定性战役在这里打响：萨伏依的欧根亲王趁奥斯曼军队渡过蒂萨河时发动进攻，取得重大胜利。1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》签订后，曾陶成为沿蒂萨河与马罗斯河设置的哈布斯堡军事边疆的一部分。

english:
The Zenú inhabited the lowlands of the Sinú and San Jorge river systems, north of the forested Paramillo mountains. Their ancestors built extensive networks of canals in the floodplains of the lower San Jorge, managing water across a vast wetland landscape. Zenú goldsmiths made ornaments notable for fine filigree and depictions of people and animals, including birds. Their goldwork later drew the attention of Spanish expeditions from the Caribbean coast.

By the time of Spanish conquest, many Zenú communities occupied higher savannas outside the most heavily flooded lands. Gold objects and burial places drew the attention of conquerors who advanced from Cartagena in search of wealth. The upper Sinú also belongs to the ancestral river country of the Emberá Katío, whose communities inhabit valleys descending from Paramillo.
simp_chinese:
泽努人居住在帕拉米洛森林山地以北的锡努河和圣豪尔赫河低地。他们的祖先在圣豪尔赫河下游洪泛平原修建广泛运河网络，治理广阔湿地的水流。泽努金匠制作精细花丝饰品，也表现人物与动物形象，包括鸟类。这些金器后来吸引了加勒比海岸出发的西班牙远征队。

西班牙征服时，许多泽努社群居住在洪水较少淹及的高处草原。金器和墓葬吸引了从卡塔赫纳出发、追逐财富的征服者。锡努河上游也是恩贝拉卡蒂奥人的祖居河流地区，他们的社群居住在帕拉米洛山地下来的谷地中。

english: Zenzevatka lies in the steppe country west of the Volga, among the small valleys of the Ilovlya basin. The village was settled by serfs belonging to the Nikiforov, von Hagen and Kamennov families. Accounts place its settlement either in the 1770s or at the beginning of the nineteenth century. Its fields formed part of the expanding estate countryside of the lower Volga, where landowners brought farming families into a region long crossed by the peoples of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 曾泽瓦特卡位于伏尔加河以西的草原地带，坐落在伊洛夫利亚河流域的小河谷间。村庄由尼基福罗夫、冯·哈根和卡缅诺夫家族所属的农奴定居形成。不同记述将定居时间置于十八世纪七十年代或十九世纪初。它的田地属于伏尔加河下游不断扩大的庄园乡村，地主将耕作家庭带入这片长期有草原民族往来的地区。

english: The Zephyr reef lies in the oceanic region west of Niuafoʻou in northern Tonga. Nearby Niuafoʻou rises around a volcanic crater lake, far from the main Tongan islands. In 1616 Dutch navigators Schouten and Le Maire sailed through the northern island group, whose communities were connected by canoe voyaging.
simp_chinese: 西风礁位于汤加北部纽阿福欧以西的海域。附近的纽阿福欧围绕火山口湖隆起，远离汤加主要岛群。1616年，荷兰航海者斯豪滕和勒梅尔驶经北部岛群；当地社群通过独木舟航行彼此相连。

sources.title: 394374421 A Revision and Critique of Atoll Numbers Based on Satellite Imagery

english: The waters west of Tonga’s northern Niuas contain submerged shoals amid the open Pacific. To the east, Niuafoʻou rises as a volcanic island inhabited by Polynesian communities. Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire reached the northern Tongan islands in 1616.
simp_chinese: 汤加北部纽阿群岛以西的开阔太平洋水域中有水下浅滩。东面是火山岛纽阿福欧，波利尼西亚社群居住于此。1616年，荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔抵达汤加北部岛屿。

english: Zerbst grew as a town of Anhalt north of the Elbe, with churches, walls and a princely residence testifying to its place in the lands of the Ascanian rulers. The division of Anhalt in 1603 made it the seat of a separate principality of Anhalt-Zerbst. Its court maintained connections far beyond the small territory: a princess of the house became Catherine the Great of Russia. After the ruling male line died out in 1793, the principality was divided among other Anhalt branches, ending Zerbst's role as an independent residence.
simp_chinese: 采尔布斯特是易北河以北的安哈尔特城镇，教堂、城墙和亲王驻地体现了它在阿斯坎尼统治者领地中的地位。1603年安哈尔特分割后，采尔布斯特成为独立的安哈尔特-采尔布斯特公国驻地。宫廷的联系远超这块小领地：该家族的一位公主后来成为俄罗斯的叶卡捷琳娜大帝。1793年统治家族男性支系绝嗣后，公国由安哈尔特其他支系瓜分，采尔布斯特作为独立驻地的时期也随之结束。

english:
Zetounion, the medieval name of ancient Lamia, stands near the Spercheios River and the routes through Thermopylae. Its fortified hill guarded the narrow passage between Thessaly and southern Greece. After Alexander the Great's death, the Macedonian regent Antipater took refuge behind its substantial city walls during the Lamian War. Centuries later the Franks, Catalans and Byzantines fought for the same stronghold.

The Catalan Company held Zetounion until 1391, when it passed to the Acciaioli dukes of Athens. Sultan Bayezid I destroyed its fortress in 1394. Byzantine forces later recovered the town, but the Ottomans conquered it again in the 1420s. Under their rule it was known as İzdin, and remained an Ottoman town until it joined the newly independent Greek kingdom in 1832.
simp_chinese:
泽图尼翁是古代拉米亚的中世纪名称，城镇位于斯佩耳刻俄斯河附近，靠近通往温泉关的道路。设防山丘守卫着色萨利与希腊南部之间的通道。亚历山大大帝死后，马其顿摄政安提帕特曾在拉米亚战争期间退入城墙避守。数百年后，法兰克人、加泰罗尼亚人和拜占庭人又争夺这一据点。

加泰罗尼亚佣兵团控制泽图尼翁，直到1391年它归于雅典的阿恰尤奥利公爵。苏丹巴耶济德一世于1394年摧毁城堡。拜占庭军队后来收复城镇，但奥斯曼人又在十五世纪二十年代将其攻占。奥斯曼统治时期，这里称作伊兹丁，直到1832年并入独立的希腊王国。

english: Zeven grew around a women's religious house moved here from Heeslingen in 1141. The new site was chosen for its greater seclusion, and the community adopted the Benedictine rule. Its estates and tithes extended over villages in the surrounding countryside, while the archbishops of Bremen exercised authority over the foundation. The convent's officers included a provost, a prioress and women responsible for its stores, property and teaching. Church and monastery gave the small settlement its importance long before the growth of a larger town.
simp_chinese: 采文围绕一所1141年从黑斯林根迁来的女子修院发展。新址更为僻静，修会也在此接受了本笃会会规。修院的庄园和什一税遍及周围乡村，不来梅大主教则对这一宗教机构行使权力。院内设有院长、女副院长及负责仓储、财产和教学的职务。早在较大城镇发展起来之前，教堂和修院便赋予了这座小聚落重要地位。

english: Zgierz is an old town in the historic land of Łęczyca. Its first known mention records a meeting here in 1231 between the Piast dukes Władysław Odonic and Konrad of Masovia. The town acquired municipal rights before 1288, and King Władysław Jagiełło renewed them in 1420. Later kings sought to encourage its prosperity: John Albert granted a ten-year exemption from taxes in 1494, and Alexander Jagiellon established three annual fairs in 1504. Zgierz remained a royal town of the Polish Crown.
simp_chinese: 兹盖日是历史上的文奇察地区的一座古镇。1231年，皮雅斯特王朝的公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥多尼茨与马佐夫舍的康拉德在此会面，这是已知最早提及此地的记载。城镇在1288年以前获得城市权利，瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃国王于1420年重新确认。后来的国王也鼓励当地发展：扬·奥尔布雷赫特于1494年给予十年免税，亚历山大·雅盖隆于1504年设立三次年度集市。兹盖日一直是波兰王室城镇。

english: Zhabna belonged to a group of small districts on the southern edge of the Novgorod lands, near the waters and portages around Seliger. Its position gave it a place in the complex arrangements between Novgorod and Lithuania. An agreement with the Lithuanian grand prince Casimir in 1440 assigned him tribute from Zhabna: twelve marten pelts, forty squirrel pelts and a payment in money, as well as provisions for brewing. Though these districts remained Novgorodian, part of their revenues went to the Lithuanian treasury.
simp_chinese: 扎布纳属于诺夫哥罗德土地南缘的一组小辖区，靠近谢利格尔湖周围的水路和拖船路。它处在诺夫哥罗德与立陶宛复杂的边地安排之中。1440年与立陶宛大公卡齐米日的协议规定，他可从扎布纳收取十二张貂皮、四十张松鼠皮、钱款以及酿造所需的供给。这些辖区虽然仍属诺夫哥罗德，部分收入却进入立陶宛国库。

english: Zhaksy Karasay is a seasonal stream at the northern edge of the Ustyurt plateau, in the dry country south of the Emba. It belongs to a closed drainage area and can dry out as the seasons change. Nearby lie low salt basins and desert plains, while the escarpment of Ustyurt rises above them. The spring runoff briefly brings water to channels that remain dry for much of the year.
simp_chinese: 扎克瑟卡拉赛是乌斯秋尔特高原北缘的一条季节性溪流，位于恩巴河以南的干旱地区。它属于内流区，河道随季节变化可能干涸。附近分布着低洼的盐碱盆地和荒漠平原，乌斯秋尔特陡崖高耸其上。春季径流会短暂地为一年中大部分时间干涸的河道带来水流。

english: Zhalauly is a broad, shallow salt lake in the steppe west of the Irtysh. Its two reaches are joined by a wide strait, and marshy ground borders the basin. The Karasu brings water during floods, but in dry years the lake can disappear, leaving salt behind. Local tradition associates its name with banners raised by Kazakh warriors during fighting against the Dzungars.
simp_chinese: 扎拉乌雷是额尔齐斯河以西草原上的宽阔浅盐湖。湖泊分为两片，由宽阔水道相连，盆地边缘多沼泽。卡拉苏河在洪水期带来水源，干旱年间湖水可能消失，留下盐分。当地传说将湖名与哈萨克勇士对抗准噶尔人时升起的旗帜联系起来。

english: The Zhaldama flows southwest across the open steppe to meet the Kara-Turgay, and their confluence forms the Turgay River. Its own headwaters are the Ashchytasty and Karynsaldy, streams draining the uplands of central Kazakhstan. Snowmelt supplies much of the water, so the river swells in spring and dwindles in the dry season. Downstream the Turgay continues towards the salt basin of Shalkarteniz.
simp_chinese: 扎尔达马河向西南穿过开阔草原，与卡拉图尔盖河汇合形成图尔盖河。它自身的源流是从中央哈萨克高地流出的阿什奇塔斯特河与卡伦萨尔德河。融雪提供了大部分水源，因此春季河水上涨，干旱季节则缩减。下游的图尔盖河继续流向沙尔卡滕尼兹盐碱盆地。

english:
Zhaling Lake lies on the upper Yellow River in the northeastern Tibetan plateau, west of neighboring Eling Lake. Cold grasslands and streams surround the lake in a highland landscape used by pastoral communities.

Qing expeditions investigated the Yellow River headwaters, including a survey led by Laxi and Shulan in 1704. Eighteenth-century geographical works described the upper streams entering Zhaling, then known as Chalinghai. These accounts record attempts to map the wider headwaters rather than a complete history of communities around the lake.
simp_chinese:
扎陵湖位于青藏高原东北部的黄河上游，在相邻的鄂陵湖以西。寒冷草原与溪流环绕湖泊，周围高地也是牧业社群活动的地区。

清代曾多次考察黄河源头，包括1704年由拉锡、舒兰率领的勘查。18世纪地理著作记载上游河流汇入当时称为查灵海的扎陵湖。这些记载反映了对河源地区的测绘与认识，并不能构成湖区社群的完整历史。

english: The lower Wuyuer spreads across the Songnen Plain into the shallow lakes and reed marshes of the Zhalong wetlands. Zhalong Lake lies beside the river, surrounded by low marshy ground. Red-crowned cranes breed among the reeds, sharing these waters with fish, shrimps and other waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 乌裕尔河下游在松嫩平原漫流，形成扎龙湿地的浅湖与芦苇沼泽。扎龙湖位于河旁，四周地势低洼。丹顶鹤在芦苇间繁殖，与鱼虾及其他水鸟共享这片水域。

english: Zhamankul is the upper course of the Tokrau, a river rising in the hills north of Lake Balkhash. Its streams gather in a wide upland valley, where the Egizkoytas burial ground preserves traces of earlier inhabitants. Spring snowmelt brings the strongest flow; farther south the Tokrau crosses the steppe and loses most of its water in sandy ground before it can reach the lake.
simp_chinese: 扎曼库尔是托克劳河的上游河段，河流发源于巴尔喀什湖以北的丘陵。溪流汇聚于宽阔的高地河谷，埃吉兹科伊塔斯墓地保留着早期居民的遗迹。春季融雪带来最强的水流；更南方的托克劳河穿越草原，大部分河水在抵达湖泊之前渗入沙地。

english: Zhamshy is a stream of the Kazakh uplands north of Lake Balkhash. Together with the neighbouring Moiynty and Tokyrau rivers, it belongs to the dry country on the lake's northern side. Low hills alternate with broad, flat-bottomed valleys across this part of the steppe and semi-desert. The streams drain southward from the uplands into an inland basin, rather than finding an outlet to the ocean.
simp_chinese: 扎姆希是巴尔喀什湖以北哈萨克丘陵中的一条溪流。它与邻近的莫因特河、托克劳河同属湖泊北侧的干旱地带。低丘与宽阔平坦的谷地交错分布，构成这一带草原和半荒漠的景观。溪流从丘陵向南流入内陆盆地，并不通向海洋。

english: Zhanaarka lies in the upland steppe near the northern Chingiztau. The range stretches across the eastern Kazakh Uplands, its slopes cut by valleys and ravines. Streams from the mountains may end in seasonal salt lakes, and willow grows in sheltered valleys.
simp_chinese: 扎纳阿尔卡位于钦吉兹套山北部附近的丘陵草原。山脉横贯哈萨克丘陵东部，山坡被河谷和沟壑切开；山间溪流可能流入季节性盐湖，背风河谷中生长着柳树。

english: Zhànchuān was a name associated with the coastal districts of the Léizhōu Peninsula. An early county called Shènchuān, also written Zhànchuān, existed here under the Sui and early Tang. In later centuries a patrol office bearing the name served Suíxī County; a Qing geographical compilation records its old site at Zhànchuān village, west of the county seat. The name thus survived in local administration long after the ancient county had disappeared.
simp_chinese: 湛川是雷州半岛沿海地区的旧地名，隋唐之际所设的椹川县也写作湛川。后来遂溪县境内设有湛川巡检司；清代地理总书将其旧址记于县城以西的湛川村。古县废去之后，这个名字仍在地方建置中延续。

english:
Zhanggu lies in the Gyelrong mountain country between the Tibetan plateau and Sichuan. Steep valleys and passes connect communities whose fields and pastures occupy different elevations.

In the Qing period, several hereditary chiefs governed parts of the wider area now known as Danba. After the Jinchuan campaigns, the Qing established Zhanggu tun in 1776 as part of a new administrative arrangement.
simp_chinese:
章谷位于青藏高原与四川之间的嘉绒山地。陡峭的河谷与山口连接各地社群，田地和牧场分布在不同海拔。

清代，今日丹巴一带分属数位世袭土司。金川战事结束后，清廷于1776年设立章谷屯，作为新行政安排的一部分。

english: Zhangming lies on the Fu River north of Mianzhou, in the country associated with the Tang poet Li Bai. Inscriptions from the Song record his family's old residence at Qinglian and remember him as a young man of the county. The place became a focus of remembrance for readers of his poetry. Under the Qing, local people rebuilt the Longxi residence and other memorial buildings around Qinglian.
simp_chinese: 彰明位于绵州以北的涪江流域，与唐代诗人李白关系深厚。宋代碑刻记述他家在青莲的旧宅，并称他少年时为本县小吏。这里后来成为诗人读者追怀的地方。清代，当地人重建青莲陇西院及其他纪念建筑，延续对李白的纪念。

english: Zhāngpíng lies among the mountains on the upper reaches of the Jiǔlóng River. A county was established here under the Míng, turning a small riverside settlement into a local administrative centre. In 1514 the magistrate Xú Fèngqí joined twenty-four boats with boards and iron chains to make a floating bridge, connecting the town with the opposite bank.
simp_chinese: 漳平坐落在九龙江上游的群山之中。明代设县，使江边的小聚落成为地方行政中心。正德九年（1514年），知县徐凤歧将二十四艘船用木板和铁链连接，建成浮桥，使城内外两岸相通。

english: Zhāngpǔ lies on the southern coast of Fújiàn. Among its settlements is Zhàojiābǎo, a fortified residence associated with descendants of the Sòng imperial family. The family’s ancestor Zhào Ruòhé came to Zhāngpǔ after the fall of the Southern Sòng in 1279. His descendant Zhào Fàn enlarged the ancestral residence in 1600, creating the walled compound.
simp_chinese: 漳浦位于福建南部海岸。县内的赵家堡是一处设有防御设施的聚居建筑，与宋朝皇室后裔有关。南宋于1279年灭亡后，赵若和来到漳浦定居；1600年，其后裔赵范扩建祖居，形成围墙环绕的堡寨。

english: Zhangqiu lies east of Jinan, where hills give way to a plain rich in springs. At Mingshui, the Baimai Spring rises in many bubbling streams and feeds the Xiu River; its clear waters were celebrated among the county's traditional scenic sights. A temple stood to the north of the spring, with a calligraphed inscription over its gate. The hills also supplied mineral resources: alum ore was mined at Pingding Mountain in the Ming period.
simp_chinese: 章丘位于济南以东，山地向平原过渡，境内泉水众多。明水的百脉泉从众多泉眼中涌出，汇为绣江，清澈的泉水是当地传统胜景之一。泉北建有梵王宫，门上悬有书法题额。周围山地也有矿藏，明代人已在文祖平顶山开采铝矿。

english: Zhangsanying lies north of Chengde on the route toward the Mulan hunting grounds. After the Qing court established the imperial hunting grounds in 1681, a chain of travelling palaces provided places for the emperor and his entourage to stay along the way. Zhangsanying was one such stopping place. Its position linked the court's journeys beyond the Great Wall with the valleys and settlements of northern Hebei.
simp_chinese: 张三营位于承德以北，通往木兰围场的道路上。清廷于1681年设立围场后，沿途设置了一系列行宫，供皇帝和随行人员驻跸，张三营便是其中一站。它将宫廷出塞行围的路线与河北北部的山谷聚落联系起来。

english:
Zhang County lies in the mountain valleys of southern Gansu, where the Zhang River runs east toward the Wei. Its older name was written with a character meaning a barrier, reflecting its place on the western frontier. At Yanjing, salt springs and wells gave the district a valuable product; brine was boiled to make salt, and the settlement remained a centre of trade long after the county seat moved elsewhere.

The region was also the home of Wang Shixian, who submitted to the Mongols in 1235 and rose through military service to govern a wide area around Gongchang. His descendants continued to hold high offices under the Yuan. In the Ming the county took the name Zhang, associated with the river that winds through its fields. Salt production at Yanjing continued under the Ming and Qing, giving the mountain district connections with markets beyond its valleys.
simp_chinese:
鄣县位于甘肃南部山谷，漳河向东流往渭水。旧县名中的“障”字反映了它作为西部屏障的地位。盐井的盐泉和盐井出产珍贵食盐，人们汲卤煎盐；即使县治后来迁往别处，盐井仍是贸易中心。

这里也是汪世显的故乡。他于1235年归附蒙古，凭军功升至巩昌总帅，管辖广阔地域，其后代在元代继续担任高官。明代县名改为漳，取自蜿蜒流过田地的漳水。明清时期盐井继续产盐，使山地县邑与谷外市场保持联系。

english: Zhangzi lies in southeastern Shanxi, where Buddhist temples stand among the surrounding hills. On the slopes of Ziyun Mountain, Chongqing Temple houses a remarkable group of eighteen painted clay arhats, made in 1079. Their distinct faces and poses lend the holy figures a strikingly human presence. In the Ming, another hall was built between 1531 and 1548 for ten judges of the underworld, with painted figures and elaborate suspended sculpture depicting the realm they governed.
simp_chinese: 长子位于山西东南部，四周山间建有佛寺。紫云山腰的崇庆寺珍藏十八尊彩塑罗汉，塑于1079年，神态各异，人物形象鲜活。明代1531至1548年，寺中又营建十帝殿，塑造冥府十王，并以悬塑装饰其身后的幽冥世界。

english: The Zhan River descends from the forested hills of the Lesser Khingan into the Sun Bira, a tributary of the Amur. Its valley forms part of a network of rivers flowing north and east through mountain country. Oroqen communities lived across these forests, where hunting and knowledge of the waterways shaped travel and subsistence. The Zhan's waters join the Sun before reaching the broad Amur, linking a smaller wooded valley to the great river of the northeast.
simp_chinese: 沾河从小兴安岭的森林丘陵流入逊毕拉河，后者是黑龙江的支流。河谷属于向北、向东穿越山地的水网。鄂伦春社群生活在这些林地，狩猎与水道知识影响着他们的行旅和生计。沾河先汇入逊河，再进入宽阔的黑龙江，把林间小谷地连接到东北大江。

english: Zhanhua lies in the low country near the Bohai coast, where rivers and marshes spread across northern Shandong. The place was formerly called Zhao'an; under the Jin it was renamed Zhanhua in 1195, when a town wall was first built. Its county gazetteer records the changing boundaries and communities of this coastal district. Salt water and shifting river channels marked the surrounding landscape, while the town served the villages and fields farther inland.
simp_chinese: 沾化位于山东北部近渤海的低地，河流与湿地交织。这里旧称招安，1195年金朝改名沾化，并开始筑城。县志记录了这片滨海地区的沿革和聚落变迁；咸水与流转的河道塑造了周围地貌，县城则为内陆村庄与田野提供地方中心。

english: This sheltered harbour lies on the eastern side of the Leizhou Peninsula, protected by offshore islands. A Ming coastal map of 1581 recorded its waters as Guangzhou Bay. After the Qing relaxed maritime prohibitions in the Kangxi reign, Chikan on the western shore grew as a trading settlement, where boats found shelter and merchants exchanged goods along the coast of western Guangdong.
simp_chinese: 这座海港位于雷州半岛东侧，外有岛屿遮护。明代1581年的海图已将其水域标为广州湾。清康熙年间海禁放宽后，西岸赤坎凭借避风港条件逐渐发展为商埠，船只在这里停泊，商人往来粤西沿海交换货物。

english: Zhanshura is a shallow lake in the northern Turgay depression, part of the Koibagar and Tyuntyugur wetland group. Its water level varies with the amount of spring runoff reaching the basin. Reeds grow across the shallows, and when the lake fills, cranes and other waterbirds use its waters and shores. The lake is one of a chain of wetlands scattered across the open northern Kazakh steppe.
simp_chinese: 詹舒拉是图尔盖洼地北部的一座浅湖，属于科伊巴加尔－秋秋古尔湿地群。湖水深浅取决于春季流入盆地的径流。芦苇生长在浅水中，湖水充足时，鹤和其他水鸟利用湖面及岸边栖息。这座湖是哈萨克北部开阔草原上散布的一系列湿地之一。

english: The dry steppe around Zhanybek lies between the Volga and Ural rivers, north of the Caspian Sea. Before the settlement was founded, Nogai, Kalmyk and Kazakh communities used this country for seasonal grazing. After many Kalmyks departed eastwards in 1771, Kazakh pastoralists increasingly crossed the Ural. In 1801 Sultan Bokey received Russian permission to lead families of the Junior Zhuz into the interfluve, forming the Inner Horde. The new horde's herds moved through a landscape of grassland and scattered salt lakes.
simp_chinese: 詹别克周围的干旱草原位于里海以北，介于伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间。聚落建立之前，诺盖、卡尔梅克和哈萨克社群在这里季节性放牧。1771年许多卡尔梅克人东迁后，越来越多哈萨克牧民越过乌拉尔河。1801年，博凯苏丹获俄国许可，率小玉兹家庭迁入两河之间，形成内帐。新部众的牲畜穿行于草地和散布着盐湖的平原。

english:
Zhanyi belongs to the eastern Yunnan plateau near Qujing, where cultivated basins and mountain routes connect southwestern China's varied environments. Grain farming, livestock, and local crafts support settlement, while woodland and upland resources add other livelihoods. Roads through passes carry merchants, officials, and pack animals between districts. Seasonal rain and elevation influence production and travel, making practical knowledge of water and routes important to community life.

Zhanyi's wider territory was governed by hereditary local rulers before Qing administrative reforms. In 1726 the hereditary prefect An Yufan was removed, and in 1727 Xuanwei prefecture was established from part of the former Zhanyi territory. These changes reshaped administration across the region around Qujing.
simp_chinese:
霑益属于曲靖附近滇东高原，耕作盆地和山路连接中国西南多样环境。种粮、牲畜和地方工艺支持定居，林木高处资源增加生计。山口道路运送商人、官员及驮畜。季节降雨海拔影响生产旅行，使水源路线实践知识对社群重要。地方生活通过资源互补及持续交换建立稳定基础，高原并非与更大网络隔绝。

清代行政改革以前，霑益较广阔的辖区由世袭地方官治理。1726年，土知州安于蕃被革职；1727年，从原霑益辖地析置宣威州。这些变化重塑了曲靖周边地区的行政格局。

english: Zhào’ān lies in the southern coastal country of Fújiàn, near the route toward Guǎngdōng. Under the Míng, the court separated four districts from Zhāngpǔ to establish Zhào’ān County in 1530. Its fields and settlements occupied a borderland between the coastal prefecture of Zhāngzhōu and the lands farther southwest.
simp_chinese: 诏安位于福建南部沿海，靠近通往广东的道路。明嘉靖九年（1530年），朝廷从漳浦划出四个都设立诏安县。这里的田野与聚落处在漳州沿海与西南边地之间。

english: Zhaoban was a patrol post of Wusa in the high country between northeastern Yunnan and western Guizhou. The Ming established it as one of several local posts under Wusa's military and civil prefecture. These posts formed part of the administration of a region where Yi hereditary rulers and their relatives held authority across scattered basins and mountain valleys, under the wider rule of the dynasty.
simp_chinese: 赵班是滇东北与黔西高地间乌撒府的一处巡检司。明代朝廷在乌撒军民府辖下设置数处巡检，赵班便是其中之一。当地彝族世袭统治者及其宗亲管理分散于坝子和山谷间的土地，巡检司则构成王朝在这一地区的行政体系的一部分。

english: Zhaohua, formerly Jiameng, occupies the meeting place of the Bailong and Jialing rivers south of Guangyuan. Its position on the old Jinniu road made it a gateway between the Sichuan Basin and the lands of Qin to the north. The walled county town stood amid river bends and mountains, a stopping place for travellers entering the difficult roads of northern Sichuan.
simp_chinese: 昭化旧称葭萌，位于广元以南、白龙江与嘉陵江汇合处。古金牛道经过此地，使它成为四川盆地与北方秦地之间的门户。设墙的县城坐落在江弯与群山之间，是旅人出入川北险道的落脚处。

english: Zhāoxìn lies in the country between Chúzhōu and the Huái River. Known as Zhāoyì under the Táng, it became Zhāoxìn County during the Sòng. The Yuán abolished the county and incorporated its lands into Xūyí in 1283, leaving the old county seat as a settlement within a larger district.
simp_chinese: 招信位于滁州与淮河之间。唐代称招义，宋代改为招信县。元至元二十年（1283年），朝廷撤销招信县并入盱眙，旧县治从此成为较大辖区中的一处聚落。

english: Zhaoyuan lies among the hills of northwestern Jiaodong, a district known for its gold-bearing rock. The mountains around Linglong and Luoshan contain numerous veins, and mining in the Dengzhou and Laizhou region was already recorded under the Song. Gold continued to be worked in later centuries, although the scale and methods of extraction changed over time. Zhaoyuan's first county gazetteer was compiled in 1660, preserving a local record of the area's people and history.
simp_chinese: 招远位于胶东西北部的丘陵间，以含金矿脉著称。玲珑山、罗山一带蕴藏着众多矿脉；宋代文献已有登莱地区采金的记载，此后历代也持续开采，只是规模与方法随时代变化。1660年，招远编成首部县志，记述本地人物与沿革。

english: Zhaozhou was a name carried across the northern Songhua plain through several changes of rule. The Jin established a prefecture of that name in 1130, at an older settlement known as Chuhe. After its abandonment during the Mongol conquest, the Yuan established Zhaozhou farther north, where a military command and a relay station served the territory of descendants of the Mongol prince Otchigin. A Zhaozhou station continued to be recorded under the Ming in the country north of the Songhua.
simp_chinese: 肇州之名在松花江北岸的平原上历经数次统治更迭。金朝于1130年在旧称出河店之地设州；蒙古征服时该州废弃，元朝又在更北面设置肇州，设万户府和驿站，属于蒙古王族斡赤斤后王的领地。明代在松花江以北一带仍有肇州站的记载。

english: Dzhargalakh lies on the left side of the Bytantay valley in the central Verkhoyansk mountains. The river descends through a country of forested slopes and high ridges, then joins the Yana farther north. Beyond the Arctic Circle, the valley experiences a long, cold winter and a brief summer. Its waters ultimately reach the Laptev Sea through the broad lower course of the Yana.
simp_chinese: 贾尔加拉赫位于上扬斯克山地中部贝坦泰河谷的左侧。河流穿过森林山坡和高山脊之间的地带，在更北方汇入亚纳河。河谷位于北极圈以内，冬季漫长寒冷，夏季短暂。河水最终经亚纳河宽阔的下游抵达拉普捷夫海。

english: Zharkhan lies on the left bank of the Chara near Tokko, in the forested south of Yakutia. The Chara runs through mountain country before meeting the Olyokma, which carries its waters northward to the Lena. Forest and river valleys surround this meeting of waterways, linking the southern uplands with the great Lena basin. Winter ice and a brief summer shape travel along the rivers.
simp_chinese: 贾尔汉位于雅库特南部森林地区恰拉河左岸，靠近托科。恰拉河穿过山地后汇入厄廖克马河，后者将河水向北送入勒拿河。森林与河谷环绕水道相接之处，将南方高地与勒拿河广大流域相连。冬季冰封和短暂夏季影响沿河出行。

english: Zharkol takes its name from a lake in the northern Kazakh steppe. In the Fedorovka country, a lake or marsh bearing this name lies among low basins of the Tobol region. Wetlands break up the open grassland and provide habitat for waterbirds, while their margins change as water collects or recedes. Many lakes of the steppe carry similar names, reflecting the varied forms of water in a dry interior.
simp_chinese: 扎尔科尔得名于哈萨克北部草原上的一座湖。费多罗夫卡地区有一处同名湖泊或沼泽，位于托博尔地区的低洼盆地之间。湿地打断开阔草原，为水鸟提供生境，其边缘随着蓄水或水位下降而变化。草原上许多湖泊有相似名称，反映了干旱内陆水域的不同形态。

english: The Dzhardzhan descends westward from the northern Verkhoyansk mountains to join the Lena from the right. In its upper course it cuts through the range that bears its name, then reaches the floodplain of the great river. The Dzhardzhan Range runs between the Lena and the higher Orulgan mountains. Together, the tributary and its valley mark a route from the mountain country into the broad lower Lena basin.
simp_chinese: 贾尔汉河从上扬斯克山地北部向西流下，自右岸注入勒拿河。河流上游切穿同名山脉，随后抵达大河的泛滥平原。贾尔汉山脉位于勒拿河与更高的奥鲁尔甘山脉之间，支流及其河谷为山地通向宽阔的勒拿河下游流域提供了一条路径。

english: Hatay lies on the left bank of the middle Lena, downstream from Yakutsk in the Tuymaada valley. Here the broad river divides around islands, with meadows and willow thickets along its channels. Spring ice breaks up on the Lena and can form jams, raising the water over the low banks.
simp_chinese: 哈泰位于勒拿河中游左岸，在雅库茨克下游的图伊马达河谷。宽阔的河流绕岛屿分成水道，沿岸分布着草甸和柳丛。春季勒拿河冰层消融时，冰块可能堆积成堵塞，使河水涨过低岸。

english: Zhaushikumtobe is a settlement mound in the Shardara country along the middle Syr Darya. It belongs to a group of medieval towns that included Sutkent and Bairkum, standing among irrigated lands and river crossings. These places linked the settled oasis with the steppe and the routes downstream toward Otrar. The earthen mound preserves traces of buildings once raised beside the river, where old channels and canals supported a network of settlements.
simp_chinese: 扎乌什库姆托别是锡尔河中游沙尔达拉地区的一处聚落土丘。它属于一组中世纪城镇，其中包括苏特肯特和拜尔库姆，分布在灌溉地与渡口之间。这些地点将定居绿洲与草原及下游通往讹答剌的道路相连。土丘保存着昔日河畔建筑的痕迹，旧河道和渠道曾在这里支撑聚落网络。

english: Zhavklant Khairkhan lies amid the dry hills and plains of the Mongolian Gobi. It is among the archaeological localities that attest to human presence in this desert long before the Mongol Empire. The Gobi's exposed rock, gravel and sparse vegetation form a cold desert landscape; prehistoric remains found across the wider region include stone tools, ancient burials and rock carvings.
simp_chinese: 札布克兰特海尔汗位于蒙古戈壁的干旱丘陵与平原之间。它是见证蒙古帝国出现之前人类在荒漠活动的考古地点之一。戈壁裸露的岩石、砾石和稀疏植被构成寒冷荒漠景观；广大地区出土的史前遗存包括石器、古代墓葬和岩刻。

english: Zhebariki-Khaya lies beside the Aldan, south of Khandyga, where the river winds through the forested country of eastern Siberia. Larch, spruce, pine and birch grow in the surrounding landscape, with poplars and shrubs along the river valleys. Winter is long and severe, while summer is short and warm; the Aldan freezes in autumn before the spring thaw releases its waters again.
simp_chinese: 杰巴里基哈亚位于汉德加以南的阿尔丹河畔，河流在此蜿蜒穿过东西伯利亚的森林地带。周围生长着落叶松、云杉、松树和桦树，河谷中还有白杨和灌木。冬季漫长严酷，夏季短暂而温暖；阿尔丹河秋季封冻，到春天才随冰雪消融再度流动。

english: Zhecheng lies among the waterways of the eastern Henan plain, where the Sha River joins the Huiji. The Yellow River's breaches brought repeated trouble to the county and made river work a shared burden. Its gazetteer records people hauling great quantities of willow branches to close a breach in the early Qing. In the Qianlong reign, work began on clearing a stretch of the Sha River from the Taikang boundary past the county's western bridge to its junction with the Huiji.
simp_chinese: 柘城位于豫东平原的河网之中，沙河在此汇入惠济河。黄河决口屡次波及县境，修河也成为地方百姓的负担。县志记载，清初堵塞决口时，柘城运送了大量柳枝。乾隆年间，当地又开始疏浚沙河，自太康县界经过县城西面的官桥，直到与惠济河汇流之处。

english: Zhehai lies in the hills southeast of Huize, in the mining country of Dongchuan. Lead ores were worked here alongside the copper districts for which the wider region was famous. The Zhehai lead works began operating under the Qing in 1741; by 1759 the authorities had fixed a levy on its output. Mining and smelting drew people into the uplands and supplied metal for the needs of the empire.
simp_chinese: 者海位于会泽东南的丘陵间，属于东川矿区。这里开采铅矿，与周边著名的产铜地区相邻。清乾隆六年，即1741年，者海铅厂开始开采；到1759年，官府已规定按产量征课。采矿与冶炼吸引人们进入山区，为帝国供应金属。

english: Zhehong lies north of Guangnan amid the mountains approaching the Guangxi frontier. In Qing times it was a military post, garrisoned by an officer charged with watching this northern approach. The Guangnan gazetteer records the chain of smaller posts leading from the prefectural town toward Zhehong, a reminder that communication across the hills depended on a succession of maintained stations. The post was one point in a wider network joining the seat of government with the frontier country.
simp_chinese: 者洪位于广南以北的群山之中，接近广西边界。清代这里设有汛地，由武官驻守，照看北方的通道。广南府志记载了从府城通向者洪的一连串塘汛，显示越过山地传递消息，需要沿途维持多个驻站。这处汛地是联系府城与边地的道路网络中的一环。

english: In the northern Gurbantünggüt Desert, long branching sand ridges run roughly north to south across the Dzungarian Basin. White saxaul and desert wormwood grow on the partly stabilised dunes, while snow covers the sand in winter. These plants distinguish much of Gurbantünggüt from the more mobile dunes of the Taklamakan to the south.
simp_chinese: 古尔班通古特沙漠北部，树枝状长沙垄大致南北排列，横贯准噶尔盆地。白梭梭与荒漠蒿生长在半固定的沙丘上，冬季积雪覆盖沙面。这些植被使古尔班通古特的大部分沙地不同于南方流沙更活跃的塔克拉玛干。

english: Zheledian lies in the mountains between the Lancang River and the Ailao range. Formerly called Zhedao, it became a native chieftaincy in 1403 after its rulers submitted to the Ming. The court acted on the recommendation of the general Mu Sheng, who described the land as extensive and populous. In 1420 the chief Dao Tan travelled to court and presented horses; the Dao family subsequently held the office by hereditary succession. In 1727 the Qing replaced the chieftaincy with Enle County under regular officials.
simp_chinese: 者乐甸位于澜沧江与哀牢山之间的山地，旧名者岛。其首领归附明朝后，朝廷采纳沐晟有关土地广、人口众的意见，于1403年设者乐甸长官司。1420年，长官刀谈入朝进马，刀氏此后世袭其职。1727年，清朝以流官治理，将长官司改为恩乐县。

english:
Zhelezin lies on the Irtysh, where the river curves through the steppe of northeastern Kazakhstan. A Russian fort was founded here in 1717 as part of the line of posts along the river. It stood on a high promontory above the floodplain and took its name from a stream entering the Irtysh nearby.

The fort was expanded in 1733 into a six-sided work with two bastions, giving its garrison a stronger position on the river. It was expanded, and its position connected it with other fortified places along the Irtysh. An exchange yard and customs post served trade across the frontier, while the river itself carried traffic between the settlements. The surrounding steppe remained a wider world of movement and pastoral life beyond the fortified banks.
simp_chinese:
热列津位于额尔齐斯河畔，大河在哈萨克斯坦东北部草原上弯曲流过。1717年，俄国人在此建立要塞，作为沿河据点防线的一部分。要塞坐落在泛滥平原上方的高岬，其名称取自附近汇入额尔齐斯河的一条溪流。

要塞于1733年扩建成带有两座棱堡的六边形工事，使守军在河边拥有更坚固的据点。它与沿河其他设防地点相联系。交换场和海关服务于边疆贸易，河流则承载聚落之间的交通。设防河岸之外，周围草原仍是更广阔的迁徙与游牧世界。

english:
Zhemgang stands on a ridge above the Mangde Chhu, overlooking the country traditionally known as Kheng. Its three divisions, upper, middle and lower Kheng, were long governed by competing local chiefs. A hermitage associated with the Tibetan lama Zhang Dorje Drakpa preceded the fortress that later rose here.

In the seventeenth century the rivalry of the Kheng chiefs drew the intervention of the Trongsa governor Chogyal Minjur Tenpa. After his forces defeated one of the rivals, other chiefs submitted to the Drukpa authorities. In 1655 Minjur Tenpa built a dzong on the site of the hermitage, one of the fortresses through which the eastern regions were brought under the central Bhutanese government. The stronghold came to symbolize the union of the three divisions of Kheng.
simp_chinese:
谢姆冈坐落在芒德曲河上方的山脊上，俯瞰传统上称为肯的地区。上肯、中肯和下肯三个部分长期由互相竞争的地方首领统治。相传藏僧张多杰扎巴曾在这里建立静修处，后来堡垒便兴建于其旧址。

十七世纪，肯地区诸首领的争斗引来了通萨总督却吉杰·敏珠丹巴的干预。他的军队击败一方之后，其他首领也向竹巴政权归服。1655年，敏珠丹巴在静修处旧址兴建宗堡，作为不丹中央政权控制东部地区的堡垒之一。这座堡垒也成为肯地区三个部分统一的象征。

english: Zhen'an lies in the wooded mountains south of the Qinling, along the middle Qianyou River. In the Tang the region formed part of Anye County, later known as Qianyou. The Ming restored an inspection post here in 1375 and established Zhen'an County in 1452 to administer scattered settlements in the mountains. Its first seat lay farther north in the Qianyou valley. Under the Qing, Zhen'an became subordinate to Shangzhou in 1725.
simp_chinese: 镇安位于秦岭南麓的林木山地，乾佑河中游流经其间。唐代这一带曾属安业县，后称乾祐。明朝于1375年复设乾佑巡检司，1452年设镇安县，管理山间分散的居民，初期县治位于乾佑河谷更北的地方。1725年，清朝将镇安划归商州。

english: Zhèn'ān was a hereditary native prefecture in the mountainous country of western Guangxi. It was governed by a branch of the Cén family, whose related houses held several jurisdictions across the region. In the Yuan, Cén Ālàxīn received Zhèn'ān while his brothers held Tiánzhōu, Sìchéng and Sī'ēn. The prefecture survived under the Ming and early Qing. In 1663 the Qing appointed a regular official to the district, and in 1729 reorganised Zhèn'ān as a prefecture under direct administration.
simp_chinese: 镇安是广西西部山地的世袭土府，由岑氏家族的一支治理，其亲族还掌握周围多个辖地。元代岑阿剌辛分领镇安，兄弟分别掌管田州、泗城和思恩。镇安土府延续至明清，清康熙二年（1663年）设流官通判，雍正七年（1729年）改设流官府。

english:
Zhending is an old city on the Hebei plain, its temples and towers rising behind substantial walls. Among its great monasteries is Longxing Temple, where a towering bronze image of the many-armed Guanyin stands within the Great Compassion Pavilion. Cast by order of the first Song emperor, the figure became a focus of devotion and a landmark of the city.

The temple was repaired and enlarged under successive dynasties. Yuan imperial patrons endowed it with land, while the Ming court supported repairs to the great pavilion. The Kangxi emperor visited under the Qing, when an imperial residence was built nearby. The monastery's halls and sculpture thus record the patronage of rulers as well as the devotion of the people who came to worship there.
simp_chinese:
真定是河北平原上的古城，坚实城墙之内寺塔林立。隆兴寺大悲阁中供奉着高大的多臂观音铜像，由宋太祖下令铸造，成为城中礼佛的重要所在。

此后寺院历代不断修葺扩建。元朝皇室赐予寺田，明廷出资修缮大悲阁；清代康熙帝多次来访，并在寺旁修建行宫。寺中殿宇与造像既记录了历代统治者的赞助，也见证着信众的虔诚。

english: Zhènfān occupies an oasis on the lower Shiyang River, north of Liángzhōu, with the Tengger and Badain Jaran deserts pressing on its eastern, western and northern edges. People had lived by the river for some 2,800 years, leaving the Shājǐng culture. The Ming founded Línhé Garrison in the Hongwu reign and Zhènfān Garrison in 1396, bringing military settlers to cultivate land watered by the river, with Mongol pastoralists beyond the northern sand. The Qing replaced the garrison with a county in 1724, and further settlement enlarged the cultivated area. In this dry basin, the distribution of canal water was a constant concern among the villages whose fields depended on it.
simp_chinese: 镇番位于凉州以北、石羊河下游的绿洲，腾格里与巴丹吉林两大沙漠从东、西、北三面逼近。约2800年前，这里已有人沿河生息，留下沙井文化。明洪武年间设临河卫，洪武二十九年（1396年）设镇番卫，军屯者利用河水开垦田地，北面的沙漠之外则是蒙古牧民。清雍正二年（1724年）改卫为县，移民与垦殖扩大了耕地。在这片干旱的盆地中，渠水的分配始终是各村落最关心的事。

english: Zhenfeng grew around Mingqiu, a Bouyei settlement in the mountains north of the Nanpan River. In 1727 the Qing established Yongfeng prefecture in lands transferred from Guangxi to Guizhou. Its first seat was at Changba, but in 1729 officials moved it to Mingqiu, where the terrain was more level. An earthen-walled town and a prefectural office followed, making the settlement a centre for the surrounding districts.
simp_chinese: 贞丰发源于南盘江北面的珉球布依聚落。清雍正五年（1727年），朝廷将广西部分地区划归贵州，设置永丰州，州治最初在长坝。两年后，因珉球地势较平坦，州治迁来此处，随后修筑土城和州署，成为周边地区的行政中心。

english: Zhèng'ān stands in the mountains of northern Guizhou, in a region long governed by hereditary native chiefs. Under the Ming, the Zhēnzhōu chiefship was subordinate to the rulers of Bōzhōu. After the defeat of Bōzhōu in 1600, the chief Zhèng Kuí submitted to the Ming and was retained as a native deputy in the new Zhēn'ān Zhou. The seat of the new administration moved several times. It was first established at Yùshuǐyuán, moved to Wúliǎnbà in 1620, and then to the foot of Gǔfèng Mountain in 1662. In 1724 the Qing renamed the jurisdiction Zhèng'ān to avoid the personal name of the Yongzheng Emperor; four years later it passed with Zūnyì Prefecture from Sichuan to Guizhou.
simp_chinese: 正安坐落在贵州北部山地，所在地区长期由世袭土官治理。明代真州长官司隶属播州土司。万历二十八年（1600年）播州败亡后，真州土官郑葵归附明廷，在新设的真安州担任土同知。州治几经迁徙，最初设于潏水园，1620年迁至毋敛坝，1662年再迁古凤山麓。清雍正二年（1724年），朝廷为避雍正帝名讳，将真安州改名正安州；四年后，正安随遵义府从四川改隶贵州。

english: Zengcheng lies on the Zeng River east of Guangzhou. Its villages and fields extend from the river plain into wooded hills. The district is associated with He Xiangu, the woman revered in Daoist tradition as one of the Eight Immortals; a family shrine at Xiaolou preserves her local story. In the Ming Hongzhi reign, parts of Zengcheng were separated to create the counties of Conghua and Longmen. The county remained under Guangzhou Prefecture through the Ming and Qing, while the worship of He Xiangu continued in temples and stories along the Zeng River.
simp_chinese: 增城位于广州以东的增江流域，村落与田地从河谷平原延伸到林木覆盖的丘陵。当地相传是道教八仙之一何仙姑的故乡，小楼家庙保存着与她有关的故事。 明弘治年间，增城部分地区先后划出设置从化、龙门二县。明清时期增城仍属广州府，何仙姑的信仰则在增江流域的庙宇与传说中延续。

english: Zhènghé lies in the hills of northern Fújiàn near the border with Zhèjiāng. Its people speak Northern Min, and the district is known for its tea. Established as Guānlì County in 1000, it gained its present name in 1115, when the Sòng emperor, pleased with its tea, bestowed upon it the name of his reign period, Zhènghé.
simp_chinese: 政和位于福建北部山地，靠近浙江，居民使用闽北话，当地以茶闻名。宋咸平三年（1000年）设关隶县；政和五年（1115年），宋徽宗因喜爱当地贡茶，将县名改为自己的年号“政和”。

english:
Zhengjia Bay belongs to the northern Yellow Sea coastal world, where sheltered water, shallow approaches, and nearby land supported fishing and maritime movement. Boats connected communities and carried food and goods between landing places. Safe travel depended on tides, shoals, weather, and knowledge of suitable anchorages. A bay's usefulness required practical access and supplies rather than shelter in a purely geographical sense.

During the late medieval and early modern centuries, the wider northern Chinese coast was linked with grain transport, regional commerce, and military communication. Ming and Qing authorities sought to supervise movement and maintain coastal security, while fishermen and merchants continued their everyday work. Trade regulations and political conflict affected opportunities, and knowledge of the coast remained essential to navigation and exchange.
simp_chinese:
郑家湾属于北黄海沿海世界，避风水域、浅水入口和附近陆地支持捕鱼及海上移动。船只连接社区，在登陆点之间运送食物和货物。安全旅行依靠潮汐、浅滩、天气及适宜锚地知识。海湾用途需要实际入口和供应，地理上避风并不独自保证可靠通行，居民经验因此持续重要。

中世纪后期至近代早期，中国北方海岸与粮食运输、区域商业和军事通信相连。明清政府试图监管海上往来、维护海防，渔民和商人则继续日常劳动。贸易规定与政治冲突影响着航运，而对海岸的熟悉始终是航行与交换的重要条件。

english: Zhengjiatun lies west of the Liao River near the meeting of its eastern and western branches. The surrounding grasslands were pasture for the Horqin Mongols during the Qing. Tradition relates that an inn opened here in 1796 to serve travelers and merchants, and that the settlement grew around it under the name Zhengjiadian. Houses gradually gathered near the inn, giving rise to Zhengjiatun. Its position on a river route helped draw people across the open pasture country.
simp_chinese: 郑家屯位于辽河西岸，接近东、西辽河汇合之处。清代周围草原是科尔沁蒙古人的牧地。相传1796年有人在此开店，接待往来客商，店铺被称为郑家店。人家逐渐在店旁聚居，形成郑家屯。临近河道的位置吸引行旅穿过这片开阔牧场。

english: Zhengping was the county seat of Jiangzhou in the southern Shanxi basin, near the Fen River. The early Ming absorbed the county into the department, whose town became a centre of craft and trade. Jiangzhou was especially celebrated for inkstones made from carefully prepared river clay, fired to a smooth, hard finish. The craft flourished in the Tang and Song and reached a high level in the Ming, before its techniques were lost during the upheavals of the Ming–Qing transition.
simp_chinese: 正平是晋南盆地绛州的附郭县，地近汾河。明初撤县并入州，州城成为手工业和商贸之地。绛州尤以澄泥砚闻名：工匠取河泥精制烧成，砚质细润坚实。这一技艺在唐宋兴盛，明代达到高峰，至明清之际的动荡中失传。

english:
Zhènkāng lies in the mountainous southwestern Yunnan frontier. Under the Yuan dynasty, Zhènkāng was the name of a circuit covering parts of what are now Zhènkāng and Yǒngdé counties. The Ming reduced Zhènkāng Prefecture to a subprefecture in 1384; after its abolition, a subprefecture was established again in 1409. Under the Qing it belonged to Yǒngchāng Prefecture.

The historical administrative area and its seat should not simply be equated with the present county. A historical place-name reference locates the old subprefectural seat in what is now Yǒngdé County, illustrating how administrative geography and names changed over time.
simp_chinese:
镇康位于云南西南多山的边地。元代设镇康路，辖境涉及今镇康、永德两县。明代于1384年将镇康府降为州，后废，1409年又设州；清代属永昌府。

历史上的行政区域及治所不能简单等同于今天的镇康县。历史地名资料将旧州治置于今永德县境内，显示行政区划和地名随时代发生了变化。

english: Zhennan occupies a mountain basin on the route west from Chuxiong. Once known as Qianshe, it became Zhennan Prefecture under the Yuan and remained part of Chuxiong Prefecture under the Ming and Qing. Travellers and official messengers passed through on the road toward Dali, making the town a stopping place between eastern and western Yunnan. The Ming built an earthen wall around the earlier seat, later replacing it with brick. In 1615 the magistrate moved the seat and built a new walled town with four gates. Schools and temples accompanied the growth of the administrative centre, while relay stations along the western road supplied travellers and carried official dispatches.
simp_chinese: 镇南位于楚雄向西道路上的山间盆地。这里旧称欠舍，元代设镇南州，明清时属楚雄府。前往大理的旅客和官府信使经由此地，使州城成为云南东西之间的驿路要站。明代曾在旧治筑土城，后来改为砖城。1615年，知州迁建治所，筑起有四座城门的新城。学校和庙宇伴随州城发展，西行道路上的驿站则为旅人供应所需，并传递公文。

english: Zhènníng lies west of Ānshùn in the limestone highlands of Guizhou. Zhènníng Zhou was established under the Yuan in 1351, though its original seat lay to the south of the later town. During the Ming, its administration was attached at different times to Pǔdìng Guard and to the provincial authorities. In 1532 the seat moved to the walled town of Ānzhuāng Guard, the site of Zhènníng thereafter. The zhou became subordinate to Ānshùn Prefecture in 1602 and retained that relationship under the Qing.
simp_chinese: 镇宁位于安顺以西的贵州石灰岩高地。元至正十一年（1351年）设镇宁州，最初州治在后来城镇以南。明代州的隶属几经变更，曾归普定卫和贵州布政司管辖。嘉靖十一年（1532年），州治迁入安庄卫城，此后镇宁便以此为中心。万历三十年（1602年）镇宁州改属安顺府，清代沿袭这一关系。

english: Zhenning lies in the valleys west of the Ziwu Mountains, south of Qingyang. Its old seat stood at Luochuan beside the Luo River, which flows southwest toward Ningzhou. The county took the name Zhenning in the Tang, after the reported discovery of jade figures in the district. It belonged to Ningzhou for many centuries, but in 1601 the Ming transferred it directly to Qingyang Prefecture. Early in the Qianlong reign the Qing changed its name to Zhengning.
simp_chinese: 真宁位于庆阳以南、子午岭以西的河谷。旧县治罗川坐落在罗水旁，河水向西南流往宁州。唐代因当地发现玉真人像的记载，改罗川县为真宁。此县长期隶属宁州，明万历二十九年（1601）改直属庆阳府，清乾隆初年又更名正宁。

english: Zhenping sits on the northwestern side of the Nanyang basin, where level land gives way to hills and mountains. The Jin established a county here in 1226, converting Yangguan town into its seat; the poet Yuan Haowen served as its first magistrate. The county endured under the Yuan but was briefly absorbed into Nanyang early in the Ming. It was restored in 1381 and kept the name Zhenping throughout the Qing period.
simp_chinese: 镇平位于南阳盆地西北缘，平地向丘陵和山地过渡。金朝于1226年升阳馆镇为镇平县，诗人元好问任首任县令。元代县制延续，明初一度并入南阳，1381年复置。此后清代仍沿用镇平之名。

english:
Zhènróng belongs to the Guyuan frontier country of northwestern China, where cultivated valleys and dry uplands connect agricultural and pastoral environments. The Song established Zhenrong as a military prefecture in 997 at the site of present-day Guyuan. After warfare with Western Xia and a subsequent peace agreement, a regulated market there facilitated exchange between the two states. The Jin later changed its designation to Zhenrong prefecture, and the Mongols renamed it Yuanzhou.

During the later medieval and early modern centuries, the wider region continued to be shaped by military administration and relationships with peoples beyond the main farming districts. Ming garrisons and later Qing arrangements organized defense, taxation, and transport obligations. Trade carried animals and other goods across the frontier, while local communities supplied food and labor.
simp_chinese:
镇戎位于中国西北固原边地，耕作谷地和干燥高地连接农耕与牧业地区。宋朝于997年在今固原设置镇戎军。宋夏战争及其后和议之后，这里设立榷场，与西夏进行互市。金朝后来改设镇戎州，蒙古时期又改为原州。

中世纪后期至近代早期，更广阔的地区继续受到军事行政以及与农区之外人群关系的影响。明代驻军和后来的清朝制度组织防御、赋税及运输义务。牲畜等货物通过边地贸易流通，地方社群也提供粮食和劳力。

english: Zhenwu was a Tang military command in the country between the Yin Mountains and the Yellow River. Its seats changed over time, linking the river fortresses with the old city of Shengle and the routes towards the steppe. The command formed part of the Tang northern frontier, where garrisons guarded crossings and governed a region inhabited by pastoral as well as agricultural communities.
simp_chinese: 振武是唐代阴山与黄河之间的军事辖区。治所曾多次迁移，连接沿河城堡、盛乐旧城和通向草原的道路。振武军属于唐朝北方边防的一部分，驻军守护渡口，管理农耕与游牧人群共同生活的地区。

english: Zhenxi lay in the upper Daying River country west of Tengchong. The Yuan established Zhenxi Circuit in 1276, with its seat near the river valleys of Yingjiang. The Ming made it a prefecture in 1382 under the authority of Luchuan. As the court reorganized the borderland, the old prefecture was replaced in 1403 by the Ganya chiefdom. Its changing titles reflected the shifting power of local rulers and the dynasty's attempts to govern the region.
simp_chinese: 镇西位于腾冲以西的大盈江上游。1276年，元朝设镇西路，治所靠近盈江一带的河谷。1382年，明朝改设镇西府，属麓川管辖。1403年，朝廷调整边地建置，改为干崖长官司。名称与建置的变化，反映了地方首领势力的消长及王朝治理这一地区的尝试。

english: Zhenxi lies in the mountain country of old Lizhou, near the routes between the Sichuan Basin and the lands west of the Dadu River. At Qingxi, an old town in the Hanyuan district, a road crossed the Niba Mountains and brought caravans towards the town gates. The surrounding slopes were known for their Sichuan pepper, a fragrant local product valued far beyond the valley.
simp_chinese: 镇西位于旧黎州的山区，靠近四川盆地通往大渡河以西的道路。汉源地区的清溪古镇是商路上的一处要地，翻越泥巴山的旅人和马帮由此进出城门。周围山坡盛产花椒，辛香的地方物产远销谷外。

english: Zhenyang lies north of the upper Huai River, in a district named for the ancient Shen River and state. An earlier county seat stood north of the later town; the county was abolished under the Yuan and re-established under the Ming. Its scholars and officials recorded the district's waterways and ancient sites in local histories. In 1723, under the Qing, the county's name was changed from Zhenyang to Zhengyang to avoid the sound of the Yongzheng Emperor's personal name.
simp_chinese: 真阳位于淮河上游北岸，地名与古慎水、慎国的记忆相连。较早的县治位于后来城址以北；元代县废，明代复置。地方士人和官员在县志中记述了境内水道与古迹。1723年，为避雍正帝名讳的同音字，清廷将真阳改名正阳。

english: Zhenyuan lies in the hills and valleys of eastern Gansu, between the approaches to Guanzhong and the northern frontier. Its name combines those of Zhenrong and Yuanzhou, the two districts united under the Yuan in 1270. The new Zhou was governed from Linjing, the site of the later county town. In 1369 the Ming reduced Zhenyuan to a county and abolished the separate seat county of Linjing. Old forts in the surrounding country recall earlier campaigns along the Song frontier with Western Xia.
simp_chinese: 镇原位于甘肃东部的丘陵河谷间，处在关中入口与北方边地之间。元代于1270年合并镇戎与原州，取两地首字命名镇原州，治所设在临泾，也就是后来的县城。明洪武二年（1369）降州为县，省去附郭的临泾县。周围旧城堡则留下了更早宋夏边地战争的痕迹。

english:
Zhenyuan stands where the Wuyang River bends through the mountains of eastern Guizhou. Its old town grew on both banks: the prefectural city on one side, the garrison on the other. The river carried boats through the valley, while roads linked Guizhou with Huguang. Bridges joined the two halves of the town beneath the steep cliffs.

The Ming built Zhusheng Bridge across the river and began the Qinglong Cave complex on the cliffs above its eastern bank in 1388. Temples, halls and pavilions were built against the rock, and the complex grew through the early Qing. Zhenyuan was also a centre of imperial government among the hereditary jurisdictions of the region. Merchants and envoys travelled through the town, where river traffic, mountain roads and religious buildings met in a confined valley.
simp_chinese:
镇远位于贵州东部山间，㵲阳河在此蜿蜒转弯。旧城分居两岸，一边是府城，一边是卫城。船只沿河穿行，陆路连接贵州与湖广；桥梁横跨江水，将陡崖下的两城相连。

明朝修建祝圣桥，并于1388年开始在东岸崖壁营建青龙洞。寺庙、殿阁依岩而立，至清初逐渐扩建成规模。镇远也是周围世袭土司地区中的官府中心。商人和使者往来于此，河运、山路与宗教建筑共同汇聚在狭窄河谷中。

english:
Zhēnzhōu belongs to the mountain country of northern Guizhou associated with Zhen'an. A historical Zhenzhou in the area was governed through a hereditary native chieftaincy, or tusi, under successive dynasties. In 1384 the Ming established the Zhenzhou chieftaincy administration under Bozhou.

After the Ming campaign against Bozhou, the former Zhenzhou jurisdiction was reorganized as Zhen'an Zhou in 1601. The Qing later changed its name to Zheng'an. These administrative changes connected local rulers and communities to shifting provincial institutions, while the mountain valleys continued to shape travel and settlement.
simp_chinese:
真州位于贵州北部与真安相关的山地。历史上的这一带曾由世袭土司治理；1384年，明朝设真州长官司，隶属播州。

明朝平定播州后，于1601年在原真州长官司地设真安州，清代又改名正安州。行政变迁将地方统治者和社群纳入不断变化的省级制度，而山地谷地仍影响着交通与聚落分布。

english: Zherdevka lies on the Savala River in the forest steppe of the Tambov country. The settlement was founded in 1745, amid the spread of villages across the black-earth lands. The Savala flows toward the Khopyor, placing the locality in the Don river basin.
simp_chinese: 热尔杰夫卡位于坦波夫地区森林草原的萨瓦拉河畔。这座聚落建于1745年，当时村庄正不断向黑土地带扩展。萨瓦拉河流向霍皮奥尔河，因此此地属于顿河流域。

english: Zherkorgan was a small fortified site east of Taraz, dating to the early medieval centuries. An earthen rampart enclosed a space longer from north to south than from east to west, while an inner wall rose on its western side. Fragments of clay vessels found there attest to the people who lived within or used the enclosure, one of many fortified places in the country around the Talas valley.
simp_chinese: 热尔科尔甘是怛罗斯以东一处早期中世纪的小型设防遗址。土垒围成的空间南北较长、东西较窄，西侧还有一道内墙。遗址发现的陶器碎片留下了曾在围墙内生活或使用此地的人们的痕迹；它是塔拉斯河谷周边众多设防地点之一。

english: Zheshart lies on the lower Vychegda. A seventeenth-century census recorded two wooden churches, dedicated to the Prophet Elijah and Saint Nicholas, together with forty peasant households; eleven yards were empty after deaths and departures associated with poor harvests and plague. By 1678 the settlement had fifty-seven households, though only one church was mentioned. A stone Church of the Savior was built between 1794 and 1807, marking the continued life of the village on the Vychegda.
simp_chinese: 热沙尔特位于维切格达河下游。十七世纪的人口调查记录了先知以利亚和圣尼古拉两座木教堂，以及四十户农家；另有十一户因歉收、瘟疫造成的死亡和迁离而空置。到1678年，聚落有五十七户，但记录中只提到一座教堂。1794至1807年，当地建起石造救世主教堂，显示这座维切格达河畔村庄的延续。

english: Zhetykol is a shallow salt lake in a basin encircled by hills. It is one of a group of steppe lakes that also includes the larger Shalkar-Yega-Kara and Lake Ayke. The Kazanche flows into Zhetykol, whose waters offer nesting and resting places for waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 热特科尔是一座浅盐湖，湖盆四周环绕着丘陵。它是草原湖泊群的一部分，湖群中还有更大的沙尔卡尔—耶加—卡拉湖和艾凯湖。卡赞切河注入热特科尔，水鸟在湖上筑巢，也在迁徙途中歇息。

english:
Zhigalovo lies on the upper Lena, a river route through the forested Siberian interior. According to the Russian-language encyclopedia account, Yakov Zhigalov established two homesteads on the riverbank in 1723, beginning the village associated with his name.

Its location on the Lena placed the settlement within a larger network of river travel. Before Russian settlement, Indigenous peoples already lived and moved across the wider region; the later village's history should not be confused with the much older history of its surroundings.
simp_chinese:
日加洛沃位于勒拿河上游，河流是穿过西伯利亚内陆森林的交通路线。据俄语百科记载，雅科夫·日加洛夫于1723年在河岸建造两处宅院，形成以他命名的村落。

村落借勒拿河与更广阔的水上交通网络相连。俄国人定居之前，原住民已在广大地区生活和迁徙；后来村落的历史不应与周围地区更古老的历史混为一谈。

english: Zhigu grew where canals and rivers meet before flowing to the sea, at the site of later Tianjin. The Jin established a stockade here, and the Yuan made the settlement a centre for transferring grain between sea and river transport. Ships brought southern grain and other goods north for the capital, while officials supervised their unloading. In 1404 the Ming established the Tianjin Guard and built a walled town near the river junction. Markets developed around the wharves, where goods travelling between north and south could be exchanged. The military settlement and its waterways together laid the foundations of a busy commercial city.
simp_chinese: 直沽兴起于河流与运河汇合、流向大海的地方，后来发展为天津。金代在此设寨，元代则将其作为海运与河运粮食的转运中心。船只把南方粮食和货物运往北方，官员在此监督交卸。1404年，明朝设天津卫，在河流交汇处附近筑城。码头周围逐渐形成集市，南北货物在此交易；军城与水路共同奠定了商业城市的基础。

english: Zhījiāng lies on the middle Yangtze, where sandbanks and islands divide the river into branches. Its name recalls this branching water. In the Eastern Jìn the county seat was moved to an island known as Bǎilǐzhōu, where old writings described fields and fruit trees along the river; the changing channels shaped both the settlement and its approaches.
simp_chinese: 枝江位于长江中游，江中洲滩使水流分为多支，县名即由此而来。东晋时县治迁至百里洲，古书记载洲上田园果木临江。变化的江道塑造了聚落和通往聚落的水路。

english: Zhījīn lies in the karst highlands of western Guizhou, a country of limestone hills and caves. The area formed part of the domain of the hereditary rulers of Shuǐxī, whose territory was divided into districts known as zéxī. Following the Qing defeat of the Shuǐxī chief, Píngyuǎn Prefecture was established here in 1665 from four of those districts. The town was long known as Píngyuǎn; Zhījīn Street and Zhījīn Pass east of the old town preserved the name by which the place is now known.
simp_chinese: 织金位于贵州西部喀斯特高地，石灰岩山丘和洞穴遍布其间。此地曾属于水西世袭土司，水西辖地分为若干称作“则溪”的区域。清军击败水西土司后，康熙四年（1665年）以其中四则溪设平远府。城镇长期称为平远，旧城以东的织金街和织金关则保存了织金之名。

english: Zhilinda lies beside the Malaya Kuonamka, a tributary of the Anabar in northern Yakutia. The river flows through the Arctic lowlands toward the Anabar basin and the Laptev Sea. Tundra, lakes and long winter ice shape this northern landscape, where rivers become open for only a short part of the year.
simp_chinese: 日林达位于小库奥纳姆卡河畔，这条河是雅库特北部阿纳巴尔河的支流。河流穿过北极低地，流向阿纳巴尔流域与拉普捷夫海。苔原、湖泊和漫长冬季的冰封塑造了北方景观，河流一年只有短时间处于无冰状态。

english: Zhishan was a district in the mountain country of northwestern Guangxi. The Song established Zhishan County under Wenzhou, and the Yuan later recorded a Zhishan prefecture under the Qingyuan and Nandan administration. Its territory belonged to a landscape of steep hills and river valleys inhabited by communities governed through local chiefs. These changing names and jurisdictions reflect the incorporation of mountain districts into the administrations of successive dynasties.
simp_chinese: 芝山位于广西西北部山地。宋代置芝山县，属羁縻文州；元代又见芝山州，隶属庆远南丹安抚司。其辖境处在陡峭山丘和河谷之间，地方社群由本地首领治理。不断变化的地名和隶属关系，反映出历代政权将山地地区纳入行政体系的过程。

english: Zhizhets stood on a narrow peninsula projecting into Lake Zhizhitskoye, southwest of Toropets. The fortified core occupied the peninsula while the settlement spread along its shores. In 1245 Alexander Nevsky defeated a retreating Lithuanian force near Zhizhets after recovering Toropets. The town later belonged to Lithuania until the truce of 1503 transferred it to Moscow. Its earthworks and the lake preserve the setting of an old frontier town linked to the Western Dvina by the Zhizhitsa River.
simp_chinese: 日热茨坐落在伸入日日茨科耶湖的狭长半岛上，位于托罗佩茨西南。设防核心占据半岛，居民区沿湖岸延伸。1245年，亚历山大·涅夫斯基收复托罗佩茨后，在日热茨附近击败撤退的立陶宛军队。此城后来属于立陶宛，1503年停战协定将它划归莫斯科。土垒与湖泊保留了古老边境城镇的地理环境，日日察河将湖区与西德维纳河相连。

english:
Zhiziluo belongs to the steep river and mountain country of northwestern Yunnan, where valleys connect the eastern Himalayan approaches with the wider southwestern interior. Cultivation occupies suitable slopes and terraces, while livestock, forest products, and local crafts diversify livelihoods. Paths traverse ridges and river corridors, linking communities whose crops, languages, and traditions vary over short distances. Rainfall, river conditions, and the difficulty of crossings shape the practical organization of exchange.

Zhiziluo historically fell within the jurisdiction of the hereditary rulers of Lijiang. After their replacement by appointed officials, intermediaries collected tribute in the area and local representatives mediated disputes. The wider region contained diverse communities with ties to Dali, Tibetan districts and neighbouring uplands. Mountain paths and relationships among communities supported travel and exchange across the valleys.
simp_chinese:
知子罗属于云南西北陡峭河山，谷地联系喜马拉雅东缘和广大西南。适宜坡地梯田耕作，牲畜、林产和工艺补充生计，小径越岭沿河，联系短距作物语言传统不同居民。降雨河情渡点影响交换组织，实际交通依赖知识合作，环境差异让地方需要广域关系获取互补资源。

知子罗历史上属于丽江土司的管辖范围。丽江改土归流后，地方中间人向这一带征收贡赋，民族代理人调解民间纠纷。更广地区有不同社群，其联系通向大理、藏区和邻近高地；山间道路与社群关系支持穿越河谷的旅行和交换。

english: Zhob stands beside the river of the same name in the highlands west of the Sulaiman Range. The settlement was once known as Apozai. In Pashto, Zhob means “oozing water,” a name carried by the river through the valley. In the early thirteenth century the surrounding country came within reach of the Mongol raids organised by Chinggis Khan.
simp_chinese: 兹霍布位于苏莱曼山脉以西的高地，坐落在同名河流的岸边，聚落过去称作阿波扎伊。兹霍布在普什图语中意为“渗出的水”，河流带着这个名字穿过山谷。十三世纪初，周围土地曾受到成吉思汗组织的蒙古袭掠波及。

english: Zhuonai Lake lies in the high, cold country of Hoh Xil. Its Tibetan name is associated with the antelope that gather on its shores: female chiru travel here to give birth before returning across the plateau. The Zhuonai River brings water from the mountains into the lake. Around it lie open alpine grasslands, isolated lakes and the rugged ridges of the northern Tibetan Plateau.
simp_chinese: 卓乃湖坐落在可可西里寒冷的高地。它的藏语名称与聚集于湖岸的藏羚羊有关：雌羚羊迁徙至此产仔，然后返回高原各地。卓乃河将山中来水带入湖泊，周围是开阔高山草原、孤立湖泊和青藏高原北部崎岖的山脊。

english: Zhokha lies in Kongpo, the forested mountain country of southeastern Tibet. It was known as a district and estate, governed by a local head within the Tibetan administrative system. Valleys and rivers divide Kongpo's mountain ranges into separate corridors, linking communities of farmers and herders across a landscape more wooded than the plateau to the north.
simp_chinese: 卓卡位于藏地东南林木茂密的工布山区。历史上这里既是一个地方辖区，也是一处庄园，由藏地行政体系中的地方官管理。河流与谷地将群山分隔为不同通道，连接农牧社群；这里的森林也比北方高原更为繁茂。

english:
Zhongbu lies among the wooded hills south of Fuzhou. On Qiao Mountain stands a tomb traditionally identified with the Yellow Emperor, a revered ancestral figure in Chinese historical tradition. Rulers sent officials to offer sacrifices there, and the site became a focus of imperial ritual as well as local devotion. Zhongbu itself belonged to Fangzhou before the Yuan transferred it to Fuzhou.

In 1371 the first Ming emperor sent an official to make offerings at the tomb and composed the text of the sacrifice. Later Ming rulers continued to dispatch representatives, leaving inscriptions that recorded their ceremonies. Qing emperors likewise sent officials to Qiao Mountain; local records describe offerings made during the Kangxi, Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns. A local academy, named for the mountain, was established in the county town in 1733.
simp_chinese:
中部位于鄜州以南的林木丘陵中。桥山上有一座传统认定为黄帝陵的陵墓，黄帝在中国历史传统中被尊为祖先。历代君主派官员前来祭祀，这里既是地方敬奉之所，也是国家祭典的重要地点。中部原属坊州，元代改隶鄜州。

1371年，明太祖派官员祭陵，并亲撰祭文；此后明代皇帝继续遣使，留下记录祭礼的碑刻。清代皇帝也派官员前往桥山，地方志记载了康熙、雍正、乾隆年间的祭祀。1733年，县城还设立了以山命名的桥山书院。

english:
Zhongdu stood on the northern plateau between the Yuan capitals of Dadu and Shangdu. Its walled city and palace were planned as a third imperial capital, at a meeting point of grassland and agricultural country. The site was known to the Mongols as Wang'uchatu, and its position lay on the route used by the court in its seasonal journeys.

In 1307 Emperor Wuzong ordered a palace and city built here soon after taking the throne. The palace was completed the following year, and offices were established to administer the new capital. Construction stopped after Wuzong died in 1311, when his successor judged the work too burdensome and abolished the capital's administration. Later emperors still visited the palace to conduct affairs and hold Buddhist ceremonies, but Zhongdu's brief career as a capital had ended.
simp_chinese:
中都坐落在北方高原上，介于元朝大都与上都之间。城垣和宫殿按第三座都城规划，地处草原与农耕地区的交会处。蒙古人称此地为旺兀察都，朝廷季节性往返两都的道路经过附近。

1307年，元武宗即位不久便下令在此修建宫城。次年行宫建成，朝廷设官署管理新都。1311年武宗去世后，继位的仁宗认为工程劳民伤财，下令停建并撤销留守司。此后数位皇帝仍来行宫议政、举行佛事，但中都作为都城的短暂历史已经结束。

english:
Zhongjiang belongs to the cultivated hill country of central Sichuan, where valleys and low ridges support a dense network of villages and local markets. Rice where water permits, dry-field crops, livestock, and crafts diversify household production. Roads and streams connect small settlements with larger centers in the wider Tongchuan region. Seasonal rainfall and water management shape the use of fields, while cooperation helps communities maintain routes and shared resources.

The county was called Xuanwu under the Sui and received the name Zhongjiang in 1012 under the Northern Song. Its later history belongs to the wider Sichuan basin, where the upheavals at the end of the Ming were followed by migration and reconstruction under the Qing. Local markets connected the agricultural countryside with administrative centres and neighbouring districts.
simp_chinese:
中江属于四川中部耕作丘陵，谷地低岭支持密集村市。适地稻米、旱粮、牲畜和工艺使家庭生产多样，道路溪流把小聚落联系广大潼川大中心。降雨水利决定田野使用，合作维护路径共有资源，地方生活需要将农业、交通与不同季节机会协调，生产基础并非均一平原。

隋代此县称玄武，北宋大中祥符五年（1012年）改名中江。其后的历史属于更广阔的四川盆地：明末动荡之后，清代出现移民与重建。地方市场将农业乡村同县治及邻近地区联系起来。

english:
Zhongkar belongs to the eastern Bhutanese mountain country, where steep valleys connect highland communities with warmer slopes and routes towards the plains. Cultivation, livestock and woodland resources support varied livelihoods. Paths and passes link settlements across different elevations, while rain, snow and river conditions shape travel.

Across Bhutan, local rulers and religious institutions played important roles before and during the consolidation of an early modern political order. Monasteries, teaching and patronage connected communities to Tibetan Buddhist traditions. Mountain routes also linked Himalayan districts with the plains, allowing exchange between places with different resources.
simp_chinese:
钟卡尔位于不丹东部山地，陡峭的河谷将高地社群与较温暖的山坡及通往平原的道路相连。耕作、畜牧和林地资源支持多样的生计。小径与山口连接不同海拔的聚落，雨雪和河流水位则影响旅程。

不丹近世政治秩序逐渐形成的前后，地方统治者和宗教机构都发挥着重要作用。寺院、教学与赞助使社群同藏传佛教传统相连。山间道路也将喜马拉雅地区与平原联系起来，让资源不同的地方能够进行交换。

english: Zhōnglí, later called Fèngyáng, was the home country of the Míng founder Zhū Yuánzhāng. In 1369 he ordered a new Central Capital built here, with walls and a palace to mark the birthplace of his dynasty. Six years later, citing the burden of labour and expense, he halted construction. The unfinished capital nevertheless remained closely tied to the imperial family.
simp_chinese: 钟离后来称凤阳，是明太祖朱元璋的故乡。1369年，他下令在此营建中都，以城墙和宫殿彰显王朝发祥之地。六年后，他以工程劳费为由罢建。这座未完成的都城仍与明朝皇室关系密切。

english: Zhongling was an old county in the uplands northwest of Shuozhou, near the frontier of northern Shanxi. Under the Han it belonged to Yanmen commandery, whose settlements stretched across the plateau. The county later disappeared, but the name recalls an early period of administration in a region where farmland, grazing country and routes towards the northern steppe met.
simp_chinese: 中陵是朔州西北高地的古县，靠近山西北部边境。汉代中陵属雁门郡，郡县聚落分布在高原各地。县治后来废弃，但旧名仍让人想起这片农田、牧地与通往北方草原的道路交汇之地的早期建置。

english: Zhōnglù was a hereditary chiefship of the Qín family in the mountains of western Hubei. Under the Ming it formed part of the network of native offices associated with Shīnán. Chief Qín Jìnxiào, who ruled in the seventeenth century, rebuilt a temple to Wénchāng and invited teachers to instruct the young. In 1734 the Zhōnglù chief joined other native rulers in submitting his seal to the Qing government; the territory was subsequently incorporated into Lìchuān County.
simp_chinese: 忠路是湖北西部山地覃氏世袭的土司，明代属于施南周围的土司网络。十七世纪的土司覃进孝重修文昌宫，延请教师教育子弟。雍正十二年（1734年），忠路土司与其他地方首领一道向清廷缴印归流，辖地随后并入利川县。

english: Zhongmu lies on the plain south of the Yellow River, between Zhengzhou and Kaifeng. Its history reaches back to a county of the Han, though its name and jurisdiction changed in subsequent centuries. Nearby Guandu became famous for the battle of 200, when Cao Cao defeated the army of Yuan Shao after striking its supplies. Old Buddhist monuments in the county include the twin pagodas of Shousheng Temple, reminders of the religious life that later grew around the settlements of the plain.
simp_chinese: 中牟位于黄河南岸的平原上，介于郑州与开封之间。汉代这里已有县治，此后名称与辖属多次变迁。附近官渡因公元200年的大战而闻名：曹操袭击袁绍军的粮草，继而击败对手。县内古迹还有寿圣寺双塔，见证了后世平原聚落中的佛教信仰。

english: Zhōngxiáng lies on the Hàn River in central Húběi, amid the fertile plains of the old Chǔ heartland. Its hills hold the Xiǎnlíng, the burial place of the parents of the Míng Jiājìng Emperor. After inheriting the throne in 1521, the emperor elevated his father’s posthumous status and ordered the former princely tomb rebuilt as an imperial mausoleum. His mother was later buried there as well, giving the complex an unusual place among Míng imperial tombs.
simp_chinese: 钟祥位于湖北中部汉江畔，地处古楚国腹地的平原。城郊山中有明显陵，安葬着明嘉靖帝的父母。1521年继承皇位后，嘉靖帝追尊父亲，下令将原先的兴献王陵改建为皇陵。他的母亲后来也葬于此，使显陵在明代皇陵中别具一格。

english: The Zhoushan Islands lie off Ningbo at the southern entrance to Hangzhou Bay. Their waters sheltered fishing communities and seafarers, while Putuo Island became a place of Buddhist pilgrimage after a statue of Guanyin was placed there in the ninth century. In the sixteenth century Chinese and Japanese pirates used the islands as a base for raids along the coast. After their suppression, Zhoushan became a port of call for foreign traders.
simp_chinese: 舟山群岛位于宁波外海、杭州湾南口。岛间水域庇护着渔民和船民；九世纪一尊观音像被安置在普陀山后，这座岛也成为佛教朝圣地。十六世纪，中国和日本海盗以群岛为据点袭扰沿海。海盗被平定后，舟山成为外国商船停靠的港口。

english: The Zhoushan Islands lie off Ningbo at the southern entrance to Hangzhou Bay. Their waters sheltered fishing communities and seafarers, while Putuo Island became a place of Buddhist pilgrimage after a statue of Guanyin was placed there in the ninth century. In the sixteenth century Chinese and Japanese pirates used the islands as a base for raids along the coast. After their suppression, Zhoushan became a port of call for foreign traders, until European commerce was confined to Guangzhou in 1760.
simp_chinese: 舟山群岛位于宁波外海、杭州湾南口。岛间水域庇护着渔民和船民；九世纪一尊观音像被安置在普陀山后，这座岛也成为佛教朝圣地。十六世纪，中国和日本海盗以群岛为据点，袭扰沿海。海盗被平定后，舟山成为外国商船停靠的港口，直到1760年欧洲贸易被限制于广州。

english:
Zhouzhi lies at the northern foot of the Qinling, where mountain streams descend toward the Wei River plain. Its celebrated Daoist sanctuary, Louguantai, stands southeast of the county town beneath the Zhongnan Mountains. Tradition tells that the sage Laozi taught the Daodejing here to the pass official Yin Xi, who had built a tower to observe the heavens.

The sanctuary flourished under the Tang and was repaired and expanded in later dynasties. Its halls, terraces and inscriptions attracted scholars and pilgrims; among the surviving monuments were works associated with the Tang calligrapher Ouyang Xun and the Yuan artist Zhao Mengfu. The scripture terrace and shrines of the Ming and Qing maintained the memory of Laozi's teaching among the wooded foothills.
simp_chinese:
盩厔位于秦岭北麓，山间溪流由此流向渭河平原。县城东南、终南山下有著名道教圣地楼观台。相传关令尹喜曾在此结草为楼、观望天象，老子西行时在楼南高岗向他讲授《道德经》。

楼观在唐代兴盛，后世屡经修葺扩建。殿宇、台榭与碑刻吸引文士和香客，碑刻中有与唐代书法家欧阳询、元代赵孟頫相关的作品。明清时期的说经台和祠宇，使老子讲经的传说继续留存于林木葱郁的山麓。

english:
Zhovkva was founded in 1597 by the Polish hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski as a fortified private town. Laid out on a Renaissance plan around a market square and castle, it stood at a crossroads north of Lviv. Poles, Ruthenians, Armenians and Jews settled within its walls, and King Sigismund III granted it town rights in 1603.

In the later seventeenth century Zhovkva became a favoured residence of King John III Sobieski. Its churches, castle and fortified synagogue reflected the patronage of its owners and the diversity of its inhabitants. The town celebrated Sobieski's victory at Vienna in 1683; the following year he received papal gifts here. A Jewish printing press began work in 1693, and Michał Kazimierz Radziwiłł founded a faience works in 1747. The wooden Church of the Holy Trinity, founded in 1720, belongs to the Carpathian tradition of timber church building.
simp_chinese:
若夫克瓦由波兰盖特曼斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基于1597年创建，是一座设防的私有城镇。它按文艺复兴式规划围绕市场广场和城堡布局，位于利沃夫以北的道路交汇处。波兰人、鲁塞尼亚人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人在城墙内定居，1603年国王齐格蒙特三世授予城市权利。

十七世纪后期，若夫克瓦成为扬三世·索别斯基国王偏爱的居所。教堂、城堡和设防的犹太会堂体现了历代城主的资助及居民的多样性。1683年城中庆祝索别斯基在维也纳获胜，次年国王又在此接受教宗的赠礼。1693年，一家犹太印刷所开始营业；1747年，米哈乌·卡齐米日·拉齐维乌创办彩陶工场。1720年建立的木造圣三一教堂，则承袭了喀尔巴阡地区的木构教堂传统。

english: Zhuanghe lies on the eastern shore of the Liaodong peninsula, where rivers descend to the Yellow Sea. In the late Ming period a settlement grew on the eastern bank of a river below Tianping Mountain. Fishing boats and trading vessels could sail upriver to load and unload there. The place became known as Dazhuangwu, and the river itself came to be called Zhuanghe.
simp_chinese: 庄河位于辽东半岛东岸，河流由山地注入黄海。明朝后期，天秤山东麓一条大河东岸逐渐形成聚落，渔舟和商船可溯河至此装卸。居民称这处地方为大庄坞，河流后来也因此得名庄河。

english: Zhuanglang guards a meeting of routes between Lanzhou, the Huang River valley and the Hexi Corridor. The Yellow River lies to the south, while the old frontier wall runs across the country to the north. The Ming established Zhuanglang Garrison here in 1372, and for a time it housed the regional military command responsible for the western frontier. In 1393 that command moved to Ganzhou. The garrison continued to protect the roads through a district inhabited by several communities, before the Qing reorganised it as Zhuanglang Ting in 1724.
simp_chinese: 庄浪扼守兰州、湟水河谷和河西走廊之间的道路交会处，南有黄河，北有旧边长城。明洪武五年（1372）设庄浪卫，负责西部边防的陕西行都司曾驻于此，1393年迁往甘州。庄浪卫继续守护道路，周围居住着多个族群；清雍正二年（1724）改设庄浪厅。

english: Zhuban-Ana is a domed mausoleum on the right bank of the Sarysu, standing on a rise above the steppe. Built of brick on a square plan, it is traditionally dated to the eleventh century and was revered as the grave of a holy person. Its name was recorded by the Orenburg geographer Pyotr Rychkov in 1762. The tomb belongs to a group of medieval monuments scattered along the rivers of central Kazakhstan.
simp_chinese: 朱班阿纳是一座穹顶陵墓，坐落在萨雷苏河右岸、草原上的一处高地。建筑以砖砌成，平面呈方形，传统上认为建于十一世纪，人们将其作为圣者之墓加以尊崇。奥伦堡地理学家彼得·雷奇科夫在1762年记下了它的名字。这座墓属于散布在中央哈萨克诸河沿岸的一批中世纪遗迹。

english: Zhucheng lies in eastern Shandong, where the old prefecture of Mizhou had its seat. The Song poet and official Su Shi governed Mizhou in the 1070s, repaired a terrace above the town and wrote his celebrated account of Chaoran Terrace. He also addressed drought and locusts and encouraged local waterworks. In 1369 the Ming abolished Mizhou and made the former prefectural seat the town of Zhucheng County, which remained under Qingzhou Prefecture through the Qing.
simp_chinese: 诸城位于山东东部，曾是密州治所。宋代诗人、官员苏轼于十一世纪七十年代知密州，修葺城上的高台并写下《超然台记》，任内还应对旱灾和蝗患，兴修水利。1369年，明朝废密州，以原州治为诸城县城；此后至清代，诸城均属青州府。

english: Zhugao lies on the southern bank of the Huai River, north of Gushi. In 1351, as rebellion spread across the late Yuan empire, the Red Turban leader Liu Futong occupied this riverside town. Its position beside the Huai placed it on a corridor of movement through the region, and the settlement later gave its name to a local district under the Ming.
simp_chinese: 朱皋位于固始以北的淮河南岸。元至正十一年（1351年），红巾军起事席卷各地，刘福通占据了这座河畔镇。朱皋临近淮河交通通道，明代附近地区以朱皋命里，保留了这一地名。

english: Zhuji lies in the old country of Yue, on the river known as the Huansha, or Washing Silk River. Local tradition makes it the home of Xi Shi, the celebrated beauty associated with the struggle between Yue and Wu. A shrine at the foot of Zhuluo Mountain commemorated her by the Tang dynasty. It was rebuilt repeatedly, and Ming magistrates left inscriptions recording the shrine and the stones associated with her story.
simp_chinese: 诸暨位于古越之地，浣纱江流经县境。传说此地是西施的故乡，她的故事与吴越争霸相连。苎萝山下的西施祠至迟在唐代已有记载，后来屡毁屡建；明代知县还留下碑刻，记述祠庙和与西施传说有关的石迹。

english: Lake Zhukey lies among the wooded hills and lakes of the Kokshetau uplands in northern Kazakhstan. Its saline water gathers in a basin at the foot of Mount Berkuty. The contrast between open water, forest and steppe is characteristic of this group of lakes, where low mountains rise above the surrounding plain and separate a series of distinct basins.
simp_chinese: 茹凯湖位于哈萨克北部科克舍套高地的森林丘陵与湖群之间。咸水汇聚在别尔库特山脚下的盆地里。开阔湖面、森林与草原相互映衬，是这片湖区的特色：低山高出周围平原，分隔出一个个不同的湖盆。

english: Zhulino is a village in the countryside east of Vyazma, among the forests and fields of the upper Dnieper region. The nearby town of Vyazma stood on a major route between Smolensk and Moscow and changed hands during the wars between Lithuania and Moscow. Rivers and small settlements fill the surrounding uplands, where the land rises toward the watershed separating the Dnieper from the Volga basin.
simp_chinese: 茹利诺是维亚济马以东的一座村庄，位于第聂伯河上游地区的森林与田地之间。附近的维亚济马坐落在斯摩棱斯克与莫斯科之间的重要道路上，曾在立陶宛和莫斯科的战争中易手。河流与小聚落点缀周围高地，地势向分隔第聂伯河与伏尔加河流域的分水岭升高。

english: The Dìngqū runs south through the steep valleys of Dêrong, receiving the Mǎyī and Shuòqū before joining the Jinsha River. From 1568 to 1639 this mountain country came under the Naxi Mu hereditary rulers of Lijiang. In 1729, under the Qing, it was placed under the Batang native administration.
simp_chinese: 定曲河穿过得荣的深切山谷向南流，接纳玛伊河和硕曲河后汇入金沙江。1568年至1639年，这一山区处于丽江纳西族木氏土司的管辖之下；清雍正七年（1729年），又属巴塘宣抚司。

english: The Zhuoshui River flows west across central Taiwan into the Taiwan Strait. At its mouth, the river meets the sea between the coastal lands of Changhua and Yunlin. Wetlands and mangroves fringe the estuary, where the river’s waters spread out toward the strait after their journey from the island’s interior.
simp_chinese: 浊水溪横贯台湾中部，向西流入台湾海峡。河流在彰化与云林之间的海岸入海，河口边缘分布着湿地和红树林。溪水从岛屿内陆而来，在此向海峡铺展开去。
